attack: seal the same fixtures twice in two batches
evidence: 6 records for 3 distinct fixtures; chain valid=True
required_fix: refuse (or skip) any fixture already present in the chain; official batch name derived from the fixture set

attack: crash after batch file write, before chain append
evidence: verify_chain=True with an orphan batch file present; no temp-file+rename, no fsync, no recovery routine
required_fix: write to temp, fsync, rename, append chain line with fsync; startup recovery that fails on orphan/partial files

attack: delete newest batch and its chain line
evidence: verify_chain=True: the chain is self-contained, so tail truncation is invisible
required_fix: record the latest chain hash outside the directory after every batch (owner-held ledger / external anchor)

attack: call the sealing function with an earlier T than the real clock
evidence: records stamped 2026-10-21T14:13:31Z accepted although the clock is later; no wall-clock or NTP/server-Date check
required_fix: official entry point must take T only from the system clock, compare it with the HTTP Date of the newest poll (skew limit) and reject explicit T

attack: feed a 2025 season snapshot of the same league
evidence: 18 results added to the state with dates 2025-10-09
required_fix: reject snapshots whose leagueShortcut/leagueSeason differ from bl1/2026 and any addition dated <= 2026-09-20

attack: a played match with no explicit 90-minute type is excluded from the state
evidence: 4 of 55 fixtures of the affected clubs stay primary-eligible with a missing match in their history
required_fix: any completed in-scope record rejected for any reason must flag both clubs (or the competition) as incomplete_history/unresolved_conflict

attack: completed result with an unresolvable team name
evidence: 2 eligible fixtures of the opponent club remain although its result is missing from the state
required_fix: unresolved/ambiguous identity in a completed record flags the competition (or the known club) as incomplete

attack: a result disappears (completed -> not completed) in a later snapshot
evidence: 18 additions retained although the newest snapshot withdrew one; amendment A1.3(1)(b) calls this a conflict
required_fix: latest snapshot is authoritative for status; a retraction quarantines the pair and flags the clubs

attack: tamper with the original-v1 preprocessing JSON or the v1 Elo parameters
evidence: verify_models never hashes: ['preprocessing_train_fitted', 'baseline_parameters'] (both are used for v1_original / v1_elo probabilities)
required_fix: hash every artifact used at prediction time (CRLF-normalised for JSON); also record hashes of feature code (v2_features.py, feature_contract.py, v2_models.py, d11, e4)

attack: change the feature generator between sealing and reconstruction
evidence: logger_code_sha256 covers prospective_logger_v2.py only; changes elsewhere surface only as a failed reconstruction
required_fix: record the sha256 of all code dependencies in each record

attack: satisfy the official gate with empty files
evidence: empty {} approval and amendment files open the OFFICIAL gate; also no official writer or directory exists (write_shadow_batch asserts namespace=shadow)
required_fix: gate must validate approval content (model hashes, protocol r2 sha256, logger code hash, batch scope) and be written by the owner; implement a separate official writer + directory

attack: kickoff moved / postponed / cancelled after sealing
evidence: reassess() classifies correctly (tested) but returns dicts: there is no hash-chained writer, no schedule/trigger, and no function that applies it to the evaluation eligibility table
required_fix: add write_reassessment_batch + verify; run it at every manual poll

attack: result dated before a fixture first appears in a snapshot retrieved after sealing
evidence: no function detects late-arriving history; the amendment does not state the eligibility consequence
required_fix: flag late_arriving_history_result in the side-car; keep eligible; report sensitivity analysis excluding them (amendment text)
